depiction_rules.notes: Provisional shared D042-D044 supporting-character contract based on the visually checked D043 S009 source photo. Use the common face, hair, age and clothing cues across chapters; source photo is not an approved character master and does not set scene pose or rendering style.

visual_bible.age: mature adult cowherd household head; exact age unspecified
visual_bible.face: warm medium-brown complexion, gently rounded or oval face, dark moustache, calm protective expression; keep face proportions consistent across D042-D044
visual_bible.hair: dark hair gathered back or simply covered by a cream head cloth; avoid changing the hairline or moustache
visual_bible.build: sturdy, naturally proportioned cowherd household head
visual_bible.clothing: simple cream dhoti with muted olive or green upper cloth or simple head covering; adapt only as required by the scene while retaining this cowherd color vocabulary
visual_bible.continuity_markers: same mature face, dark moustache, dark gathered/covered hair, cream dhoti and muted olive/green clothing; distinct from Garga’s elderly white-bearded ascetic look and Vasudeva’s longer dark hair and fuller beard

shared_identity_reference.role: shared provisional D042-D044 adult identity cue only; not an approved character master or scene/style reference

never: no duplicate Nanda in one scene
do not imply that this is an approved master
